execution_message.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: KCK-03B2 individual model-sheet candidate, NOT animation or production. Input image 1 is the ONLY approved identity and rendering reference. Keep the exact Soft Handmade 2.5D illustrator treatment: dark warm brown hand outline, controlled fine paper/pencil grain, flat base colors with gentle volume, soft upper-left light. One isolated whole-body character only, genuine transparent background; no text, labels, panels, duplicates, floor, cast shadow, white matte or new props. Square canvas; entire ears, tail, feet and required prop inside a generous transparent margin on all sides. Keep approximately the same character mass/size and proportions across sheets; do not enlarge the head or shrink limbs. Eyes keep reference anatomy: large primary white glint in the UPPER LEFT of each visible open eye, small secondary glint LOWER RIGHT. Light direction is SCREEN upper left regardless of body rotation. Do not mirror the reference or transfer props between anatomical hands. This is one still PNG, no collage. Subject: approved mint Dinosaur dinosaur-01 from corrected A3. Same large head and short rounded body; deep warm brown round eyes with no iris/white sclera, peach cheeks, little w-shaped smile, cream belly with EXACTLY TWO separate curved brown lines, soft yellow rounded dorsal spikes from head down back to long tail, two short feet with toe marks. Magnifying glass with yellow-orange handle/frame and pale blue lens stays held by DINOSAUR'S LEFT hand (viewer right in front view); other hand near chest. Keep all identity colors and head/body proportion. Open-eye primary highlight centroid approximately x=0.35,y=0.28 within each eye's bounding box, secondary smaller below/right; do not put primary glint on right. View: strict orthographic BACK, head and torso face away. No visible eyes, nose, mouth, cheek circles or front belly panel. Preserve anatomical handedness: raised LEFT paw or magnifying-glass hand now on viewer LEFT. Show plausible continuous tabby stripes or yellow dorsal spine/tail in same reference style; any previously unseen back detail is a proposed candidate, do not invent decorations. Keep pose and full-body proportions. BACK overrides front-face feature descriptions: no eyes/highlights, cheeks, mouth, cream belly or belly lines visible on the rear. Do not paste a front belly patch onto back. Show the ORIGINAL magnifying glass held in anatomical LEFT hand (viewer LEFT from behind), raised at the side; its lens may be visible at side. Yellow rounded dorsal spikes form one coherent anatomical dorsal row continuing from head down back to tail, not duplicated decoration. Keep original short standing legs, same tail pose and head/body masses; use actual back view of whole head/torso, not front silhouette without eyes.
